name: Co-op
author: UnderRailWorks
description: Play together (in development). Host from the Co-op button on the HUD; others use Join a Game on the main menu, make a character in the game's own creation (or pick one saved with the host's game), and play it in the host's world: walking, fighting, doors and objects, looting, exits (the group travels), conversations. Players can be in different zones (whoever is alone in a zone runs it). Other mods that use Works' Party.Members include the co-op characters.
